Our engineering team of 12 is struggling with delivery velocity. Sprint completion rate has dropped from 85% to 60% over the last two quarters. Our monolithic Rails application is hitting scaling limits at 10,000 concurrent users. P95 latency has degraded from 200ms to 800ms. We need to decide: full microservices migration (estimated 12 months, £500k), or targeted performance optimisation of the 3 bottleneck endpoints with caching and read replicas (estimated 3 months, £80k). Our SLA requires P95 latency under 500ms.
The programme is backed by a government grant worth up to £225,000 over three years.
